title: The Cruel Prince
author: Holly Black
summary: A human girl raised in the fae High Court after her parents' murder longs to belong in a place that despises her. She chases power through its schemes, which pits her against the cruel prince who torments her most.
readIf: you want a twisty, scheming fae court story with an ambitious heroine and a hero who is both enemy and temptation.
skipIf: you want warm characters, since almost everyone here lies, bullies or plays a game.

pairings.reason: Another fae-court fantasy, with more romance and a very different, less cruel male lead.
A comparably clever and morally murky YA fantasy with scheming and double-crosses.
A fairy-tale fantasy with a powerful, prickly hero and a heroine who finds her own strength.
